selectedAssets.alt: Four fictional adult women in short bronze-blue, pearl-lilac, ruby-ivory, and emerald-cobalt RAZE looks wear black thigh-high hosiery and pumps above Luxembourg City's Alzette valley and stone viaducts.
Four fictional adult women in sharply short teal, gold-blue, magenta-black, and emerald RAZE looks wear rainbow knee-high stockings and pumps at an overlook below Luxembourg's Vianden Castle.

Four fictional adult women in sharply short metallic bronze, copper, ruby, and cobalt RAZE looks wear dark thigh-high hosiery and pumps beside the Schiessentumpel cascade and arched stone bridge in Mullerthal.

Four fictional adult women in sharply short bronze, pale rose, teal-black, and plum RAZE looks wear rainbow bands and tall branded statement boots with split-star heels at Esch-Belval, with stylized smoke far behind the blast furnaces.
